About me

Hello, I'm Phil. I've been a web designer and developer for many, many years. Since being made redundant in October 2026, I decided to branch out on my own and start a business which involves some passions as well as the career I'm experienced in.

Treading the boards

My first real passion was theatre. I did a RSA Performing Arts Certificate in 1987 -1989 (as well as 3 'A' Levels, no idea how I find the time) at Stockton & Billingham Technical College. Despite the college's name, it was quite a renowned course - we had visiting lecturers from New York, a local playwright teaching us & the course spawned some actors who are working to this day.

I played countless roles, notably learning how to dance the Charleston & a very loud Queen of Hearts in Alice in Wonderland ("off with his head!!").

After that, I went to Lancaster University for my first degree in Theatre Studies. In my first year alone I was involved in 12 productions. Again, no idea how I found the time.

Musical switch

I'd been a songwriter throughout this time. While at university I wrote musicals (!) & performed solo. Then I got a band together - actually strictly various bands all with me and a mate, a drummer, and a 2nd guitarist at their core. That was when I really got interested in writing and performing music. I didn't really do any theatre after university.

These days, umpteen years on, I'm more interested in writing and production (and making films to go along with the music).

The Web

By the end of the 1990s, I was getting a bit tired of having no money & working crap, unsatisfying jobs. So I re-trained into the world of digital via an MSc at Huddersfield University. This was around the time of the dot com bubble. Unfortunately, the web lecturer was a flaky so-and-so and his lectures were far and few between so everything I learned about building websites I had to doggedly teach myself.

I've designed and designed & built countless websites and bits for websites in my time via permanent jobs, agency & freelance work. You can view my recent web work over here.

Filmmaking

I'm a child of the 1970s so I've always loved TV & films. I wanted another outlet for creativity in the 2010s so I started by making music videos for young bands. I progressed onto drama by (perhaps foolishly) doing a trio of shorts as my first dialogue-based foray. I knew nothing, recorded them on a crappy old consumer video camera. You can view some of my more recent efforts on the video & film page.

Music making continues...

I continue to record and release music to Bandcamp (and there's some on Spotify although I'm not a fan/don't have an account) & am starting to bring together my love of filmmaking and music for a new project. Watch this space - or, more specifically, the songwriting & production page.

So that's me, you're all caught up. If you want to get in touch about a collaboration, a project, any old thing really feel free to use the talk to me form.

See you soon!
